task_tools: Same shell, file inspection/editing and task-provided build/test tools within a configuration; exact scaffold and resource limits pending protocol freeze.
external_network: Disabled by intended material-isolation policy; dependency access, if required, must be preprovisioned or identically allowlisted and registered for all arms. No open retrieval of excluded corpus.
mount_policy: Mount only the selected arm directory as /experiment/materials. Never mount audit-only, the entire repository, siblings, graders, or oracles. A has zero-byte injection and no reference files.
source_links: External URLs and excluded relative script/example links in references are provenance only, not retrieval authorization. No bundled helper scripts in any arm. Equivalent task tools remain available in all arms.
enforcement: Specification only; runner isolation and tool equality require a later preflight check before freeze.
